text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin crosses the finish line in<n>the autumn
Tenno Sho alongside the<n>dreams of many, with a
smile of pure<n>joy on her face.

Her doubts are gone. She's going to<n>keep enjoying
running for herself.<n>And I bet she'll turn all those
cheers<n>into her driving force.

With that in mind, I decide to make our<n>next race the
one she'll enjoy most.

We're taking on the Japan Cup, a<n>race in which
runners from around<n>the globe compete. And
knowing Ines,<n>I'm confident she'll be able to enjoy
herself more than anyone in the<n>world!
